name: Git
description: Official Git version-control tools and installation guidance for Windows, macOS and Linux development environments.
license_note: Git is free software distributed under its published open-source licence. Platform package maintainers may provide additional packaging.
notes: Use the package for the target operating system and architecture.
On Linux, the distribution package manager may provide the recommended build.
Do not place access tokens or private keys in Git remotes or repository files.
